title.en: Timing and the experience remain separate information
title.zh: 时间与经历是不同信息

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的舒四条依次选部分符合、很符合、未计分、与回忆不符；晞对调前两条，六类计数仍相同，却分别对应感受变化与低落。两人都不能从一项很符合得出发生很多天、程度很重或由激素引起。舒只记得同一次月经开始前的经历，时间不清的那条可保留，不用查消息或回到难受情境来补答案。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Shu selects matches partly, matches closely, unscored and does not match; Xi swaps the first two. Identical category counts now refer to different descriptions of shifting feelings and lower mood. A closely matching description establishes no day count, intensity or hormonal cause. Shu recalls the same period start and can leave uncertain timing unscored without searching messages or recreating an upsetting situation.

title.zh: 保留自愿咨询问题与隐私

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样把贴切标签、回忆时间与没有核实的原因分别读？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替任何真人作答、不要求个人周期记录，也不把讨论当作临床核查。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a match label, remembered timing and an unverified cause be kept separate?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without proxy answers, personal cycle records or treating discussion as clinical verification.

paragraphs.zh: 本页16条为费马原创成人回顾，不是DRSP、PSST、发表PMDD题本或临床筛查。参照同一次记得的月经开始前后，以每条所述时间为准；不收日期、周期史、逐日记录或个人叙述，不预设性别、妊娠史、家长身份或规则周期。六类是与回忆不符、稍微符合、部分符合、大体符合、很符合、未计分；标识0至4仅为ID，不是频率、天数、症状强度或点数。四主题各四条，每主题六类计数合计4，并保留16条所选标签。未计分可指无经历、回想或时间不清、不愿回答，页面不区分原因；与回忆不符不是未计分，不填零、不猜中间值。每条各选给定类别才整理记录，全未计分也能完成；不加总、求均值、排名或选最高主题。经期后仍继续的描述不反向、不扣除缓解。回顾不确认周期阶段、排卵、重复模式、激素原因、PMDD或其他状况，也不确认身体变化无害；没有常模、临床阈值、验证或双语测量等值。之后类别不同不证明改善、恶化、真实周期变化或治疗有效。OWH资料介绍更广评估及时间术语背景，不验证原创描述或新增虚构情境；一次回忆不替代前瞻逐日观察或专业评估，网站也不要求先有日记才能咨询。四篇七节全文与支持始终公开，不答、未计分、退出均可读。可选讨论只用虚构信息，无需本人记录、周期史、身体测量、重看消息、追踪、改变睡眠饮食、重演分歧或披露经历。答案及整理记录仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址；完成清除作答状态，退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录，重新开始不恢复。复制只含公开标题及入口，不含类别或周期信息；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或别人已看到的信息。已有照护、专业意见与安全支持独立保留，不据类别改药、改避孕安排、取消支持、推迟评估或忽略选定日子之外的担忧。可以不完成、不达到计数、不再等周期就询问合格专业人员；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不继续以此页作判断。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult recollections are not DRSP, PSST, a published PMDD form or a clinical screen. Refer to the same remembered period start and each statement’s timing. No dates, cycle history, daily entries or personal narrative are collected; gender, pregnancy history, parenthood and regular cycles are not assumed. Six categories are does not match my recollection, matches slightly, partly, mostly, closely and unscored. IDs zero through four are not frequency, days, intensity or points. Four themes contain four descriptions each. Six counts sum to four per theme, with all 16 selected labels retained. Unscored covers no experience, unclear recall or timing, or withholding without identifying the reason. Does not match is distinct from unscored; no zero or midpoint is imputed. Every description needs an offered category to organize a record, and all-unscored can finish. No totals, averages, rankings or highest topic are assigned. Continuing feelings after a period are not reversed or subtracted from easing. Recollection verifies no phase, ovulation, recurrence, hormonal cause, PMDD or other condition and certifies no physical change as harmless. No norms, clinical thresholds, validation or bilingual measurement equivalence are established. Changed categories prove no improvement, deterioration, true cycle change or treatment effect. OWH supplies broader assessment and timing background, not validation of these descriptions or fictional scenes. Recollection replaces neither prospective daily observations nor professional assessment, and the website requires no diary before an enquiry. All four seven-section guides and support stay public without answers, with unscored responses or after leaving. Optional discussion uses fiction without personal records, cycle history, body measurements, message review, tracking, altered sleep or food, reenacted disagreements or disclosure. Answers and records stay in page memory without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or personal-result addresses. Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record without restoration. Copying includes only the public title and entry, not categories or cycle information. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. Keep existing care, professional advice and safety support independent. Categories justify no medicine or contraception changes, cancelled support, delayed assessment or dismissal of concerns outside the selected days. You can ask a qualified professional without completion, a count or another cycle. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance rather than a decision through this page.

title.en: An interruption and its meaning remain different
title.zh: 打断与其意义保持区别

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的若记得同一次经期前，小打断更烦躁这一条大体符合，语气生硬这一条与回忆不符，另两条未计分。遥的同样计数对应不同陈述，不能说二人以同样方式处理分歧。想保持距离也不证明实施过冲突行为；网页没有交流经过，不判谁有错，不以周期时间解释掉现实边界或要求对质。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Ruo selects mostly matches for irritation at an interruption, does not match for a sharper tone, and unscored for two other statements around the same period start. Yao has identical counts on different descriptions, establishing no shared conflict style. Wanting distance proves no action. Without an account of an exchange, the page assigns no blame, dismisses no practical boundary through timing and requires no confrontation.

title.en: Keep a question without a confrontation task
title.zh: 留下问题，不作对质任务

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样谈虚构人物的一条回忆，同时不判定责任或要求重演互动？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替任何真人作答、不要求个人周期记录，也不把讨论当作临床核查。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a fictional recollection be discussed without assigning blame or reenacting an interaction?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without proxy answers, personal cycle records or treating discussion as clinical verification.

title.en: Sleep, appetite and opportunity are different information
title.zh: 睡眠、食欲与机会是不同信息

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的澜四条依次选与回忆不符、部分符合、未计分、大体符合：记得安睡感觉不同、活动精力较少，但不愿回答想吃东西那条。桐也选未计分，却是记不起那次时间；两种原因网页不区分。部分符合不说明睡了几小时，精力标签不说明身体变化无害或只是周期性；不为填表检查身体、改一餐或熬夜比较。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Lan selects does not match, matches partly, unscored and matches mostly: remembering different settling into sleep and less energy, while withholding the food description. Tong also selects unscored but cannot recall timing; the page distinguishes neither reason. Partly matching estimates no sleep hours, and an energy label certifies no physical change as harmless or only cyclical. No body checks, altered meals or staying awake for comparison are needed.

title.en: Keep an optional question without a body-checking task
title.zh: 留下自愿问题，不做身体检查任务

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样保留身体或作息方面的疑问，而不把标签当成无害证明？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替任何真人作答、不要求个人周期记录，也不把讨论当作临床核查。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a question about a physical change or routine remain open without using a label as an all-clear?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without proxy answers, personal cycle records or treating discussion as clinical verification.

title.en: Easing and continuing need not cancel each other
title.zh: 缓解与继续不必相互抵消

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的槿四条依次选大体符合、部分符合、很符合、未计分，既记得开始后某些感受接近平时，也记得部分感受继续。后者不反向扣除前者，不能把三条贴切标签合成临床模式；另一段近期时间也只是回忆，不是测量对照。保持这些未知不要求再等一个周期、重开追踪应用或建立日记才咨询。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Jin selects mostly matches, partly matches, closely matches and unscored, recalling both some easing after the period began and some continuing feelings. Continuing is not reversed or subtracted from easing, and three matching labels do not form a clinical pattern. Another recent time is recalled context rather than a measured control. Uncertainty creates no requirement to wait another cycle, reopen a tracking app or establish a diary before asking a professional.

title.en: Keep the uncertainty in an optional conversation
title.zh: 自愿交流时也保留不确定

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“为什么缓解和继续可以同时记录，而不相减或确定诊断？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替任何真人作答、不要求个人周期记录，也不把讨论当作临床核查。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Why can easing and continuing both be recorded without subtraction or a diagnosis?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without proxy answers, personal cycle records or treating discussion as clinical verification.

paragraphs.zh: 本页16条为费马原创成人回顾，不是DRSP、PSST、发表PMDD题本或临床筛查。参照同一次记得的月经开始前后，以每条所述时间为准；不收日期、周期史、逐日记录或个人叙述，不预设性别、妊娠史、家长身份或规则周期。六类是与回忆不符、稍微符合、部分符合、大体符合、很符合、未计分；标识0至4仅为ID，不是频率、天数、症状强度或点数。四主题各四条，每主题六类计数合计4，并保留16条所选标签。未计分可指无经历、回想或时间不清、不愿回答，页面不区分原因；与回忆不符不是未计分，不填零、不猜中间值。每条各选给定类别才整理记录，全未计分也能完成；不加总、求均值、排名或选最高主题。经期后仍继续的描述不反向、不扣除缓解。回顾不确认周期阶段、排卵、重复模式、激素原因、PMDD或其他状况，也不确认身体变化无害；没有常模、临床阈值、验证或双语测量等值。之后类别不同不证明改善、恶化、真实周期变化或治疗有效。OWH资料介绍更广评估及时间术语背景，不验证原创描述或新增虚构情境；一次回忆不替代前瞻逐日观察或专业评估，网站也不要求先有日记才能咨询。四篇七节全文与支持始终公开，不答、未计分、退出均可读。可选讨论只用虚构信息，无需本人记录、周期史、身体测量、重看消息、追踪、改变睡眠饮食、重演分歧或披露经历。答案及整理记录仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址；完成清除作答状态，退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录，重新开始不恢复。复制只含公开标题及入口，不含类别或周期信息；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或别人已看到的信息。已有照护、专业意见与安全支持独立保留，不据类别改药、改避孕安排、取消支持、推迟评估或忽略选定日子之外的担忧。可以不完成、不达到计数、不再等周期就询问合格专业人员；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不继续以此页作判断。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult recollections are not DRSP, PSST, a published PMDD form or a clinical screen. Refer to the same remembered period start and each statement’s timing. No dates, cycle history, daily entries or personal narrative are collected; gender, pregnancy history, parenthood and regular cycles are not assumed. Six categories are does not match my recollection, matches slightly, partly, mostly, closely and unscored. IDs zero through four are not frequency, days, intensity or points. Four themes contain four descriptions each. Six counts sum to four per theme, with all 16 selected labels retained. Unscored covers no experience, unclear recall or timing, or withholding without identifying the reason. Does not match is distinct from unscored; no zero or midpoint is imputed. Every description needs an offered category to organize a record, and all-unscored can finish. No totals, averages, rankings or highest topic are assigned. Continuing feelings after a period are not reversed or subtracted from easing. Recollection verifies no phase, ovulation, recurrence, hormonal cause, PMDD or other condition and certifies no physical change as harmless. No norms, clinical thresholds, validation or bilingual measurement equivalence are established. Changed categories prove no improvement, deterioration, true cycle change or treatment effect. OWH supplies broader assessment and timing background, not validation of these descriptions or fictional scenes. Recollection replaces neither prospective daily observations nor professional assessment, and the website requires no diary before an enquiry. All four seven-section guides and support stay public without answers, with unscored responses or after leaving. Optional discussion uses fiction without personal records, cycle history, body measurements, message review, tracking, altered sleep or food, reenacted disagreements or disclosure. Answers and records stay in page memory without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or personal-result addresses. Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record without restoration. Copying includes only the public title and entry, not categories or cycle information. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. Keep existing care, professional advice and safety support independent. Categories justify no medicine or contraception changes, cancelled support, delayed assessment or dismissal of concerns outside the selected days. You can ask a qualified professional without completion, a count or another cycle. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance rather than a decision through this page.
